steps.description: The song's number in CCLI SongSelect. The Song Usage report lists it. Leave it blank for a public-domain or original song.
steps.label: CCLI Number
steps.title: CCLI Number

steps.description: Add the authors and the copyright line as the publisher gives them. To add a theme, such as Advent, add a tag in the sidebar of the form. Filter the Song list by a tag to find the songs of a theme.
steps.label: Song Details
steps.title: Song Details

steps.description: Tick this only when the words and the music are free of copyright. Visitors who are not signed in can see the slides of a public-domain song in a presentation, and no other song.
steps.label: Public Domain
steps.title: Public Domain

steps.description: The key the team usually plays the song in, with its tempo in beats per minute and its time signature. Each arrangement can have its own key.
steps.label: Key and Tempo
steps.title: Key and Tempo

steps.description: Add one row for each way the team plays the song, with its key and its chart in ChordPro: put each chord in square brackets before the syllable, for example [G]Amazing [D/F#]grace. After you save, Chord Chart shows the chart in any key, and Make Slides from ChordPro makes the slides from it.
steps.label: Arrangements and ChordPro
steps.title: Arrangements and ChordPro

steps.description: Attach chord charts, lead sheets and recordings, or add a link. The people who serve at a function with this song open them from their Ministry Team page. Nobody else can open the files.
steps.label: Rehearsal Media
steps.title: Rehearsal Media

steps.description:
The lyrics on screen, one slide for each part of the song. Click Present to show them on a screen. Make Slides from ChordPro makes them again from an arrangement.

Add at least one slide to continue.
steps.label: Lyric Slides
steps.title: Lyric Slides
